system.flavor:
Make a sentry lose his count, a clerk skip a line in the ledger, a dog forget what it was sniffing, or a guard glance the wrong way for one breath while a friend slips past.

Not enough to make anyone forget a face or hold them dazed for longer than a moment.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, it is also Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
Deal 1 Psychic Damage on a hit.

rider.title: Strain - Fracture
rider.html: If you accepted Strain and hit, learn which of the target's Fortitude and Composure is lower.
